messages:
Noah Park: Heads-up: prospect (global payments) wants an air-gapped POC. Key asks: signed artifact chain, transfer size cap 3.5GB/day, no reboots during core hours, and a documented upgrade cadence.
Evelyn Brooks: Got it. Core hours = 13:00-21:00 local. They insist on file-level signed chunks and a manifest with monotonic versioning.
Diego Martinez: We should propose a dual-cadence: quarterly security-only hotfixes + annual feature upgrades. Emergency patches can be handled as paid expedited releases.
Sasha Ivanov: Technical constraints: GPU firmware updates require maintenance windows and reboots. App-level model swaps and agent patches can be non-reboot with our applyer. Need to classify every CVE fix.
Noah Park: They also flagged procurement: cannot accept outside-signed artifacts unless chain-of-custody docs are provided. HSM integration requested as an option.
Evelyn Brooks: HSM signing on their side is preferred. If they want Redwood to sign, it's a PS add-on with per-artifact ops. We'll include both options in the proposal.
Diego Martinez: Transfer plan: chunk numbered tarballs (0001.tar.gz ..), manifest.sha256, detached signature bundle.sig (DER). Applyer will support `--verify-only`, `--dry-run`, and resume.
Packaging Bot: pack-bot: sample-chunk-manifest uploaded: s3://poc-artifacts/1775001234/manifest.sample.json
Sasha Ivanov: Security team: require SBOM (SPDX JSON), signed provenance file, and an offline audit log that records approver identity + signature. Also need offline cert rotation steps.
Noah Park: Pricing Q: how much to include HSM signing + customer-specific SBOM generation?
Diego Martinez: Rough estimate: one-time integration 2 engineer-weeks + 1 week QA. Also add monthly ops fee if we manage signing on their behalf. I'll put numbers in the SOW.
Evelyn Brooks: SOW deliverables: signed SBOMs, chunking tooling + applyer, verification scripts, runbook (including cert rotation and recovery), 2x remote assist sessions, optional onsite day.
Sasha Ivanov: Legal note: they'll run our workflow through their security questionnaire and want a threat model for offline transfer. Expect 3-4 week review.
Noah Park: Ops constraint: they only accept physical transfer via secured jumpbox. We should provide MD5/sha256 checks and a human ack step before apply.
Diego Martinez: We'll add journaling lines: approver name, role, timestamp, signature hash appended to audit.log. That satisfies compliance.
Packaging Bot: pack-bot: applyer smoke tests: pass (unit+integration) - artifact: 1775001234-applyer-v0.3.tar.gz
Evelyn Brooks: Next steps: Diego to draft PS pricing + SOW, Sasha to draft security appendix (cert rotation, threat model), Noah to prepare AE one-pager. Target: draft to customer by EOD Friday.
Noah Park: Thanks everyone — let's keep the proposal tight and explicit about what requires reboots vs hot-patchable. :thumbsup:
